answer: Vouching with shared liability: a newcomer agent can only join if an established member stakes part of its own bond as a harbor for them. If the newcomer is later proven a clone, the voucher loses that stake too, so honest agents stop vouching for strangers who graze the same meadow of identical outputs. As fake sign-ups rise like a tide, each one needs a separate sponsor risking real capital, so a sybil farm quickly runs out of willing backers.
